measure_name: Green data centres and sustainable facilities
definition: A commitment to design, build, retrofit or operate data centres and ICT facilities on sustainability principles: efficient cooling, a power usage effectiveness target, renewable-powered facilities, water-efficient design, waste heat recovery, sustainable building standards. Counts when the measure is financed or required for the facility. Does not count: data centre construction with no sustainability measure named.
note: First cut from Dev's measure template, 2026-10-20; patterns anchored to a climate or energy word where the bare word would match thousands of sentences.
